source: User annotations in bench PDF, visually transcribed; user confirms USB physically disconnected for revised readings.
measurement_kind: Reported steady DC readings in two reset states; no simultaneous waveform capture.

prior_USB_connected_control.source: Earlier PDF values transcribed in conversation; user then confirmed USB was connected. They are not battery-only observations.

interpretation: D+ and VBUS collapse on RESET while steady +3V3 remains unchanged. This strongly supports the inferred ESP32 D+ -> R13 -> U4 upper steering diode -> raw VBUS path. The 0.79 V difference is consistent with forward diode conduction, not component-specific proof.
limits: U4 pin 5 has not been physically isolated.
Steady meter readings do not exclude short supply transients.
Battery voltage, firmware/mode and meter input impedance were not supplied.
No hardware remedy has been applied or validated.
next_discriminating_test: Optional diagnostic reference only: isolate U4 pin 5 and repeat battery-only readings. The user has elected to proceed without this test.

design_decision.accepted_working_diagnosis: ESP32 D+ -> R13 -> U4 upper steering diode -> raw VBUS
design_decision.basis: User accepts the existing measurements as sufficient basis to proceed with the redesign.
design_decision.reason: User does not have the tools to perform pin-isolation rework.
